title: Native resource store in the platform cache directory
description: Run on the owned iOS simulator and Android emulator with a SQLite-enabled dev build. Verifies the real app store and reruns portable conformance through the actual Expo SQLite adapter in an isolated proof database.

proofTargets.claim: The app opens its resource database under the platform cache directory and SQLite integrity is valid.
The actual Expo SQLite adapter passes all eighteen portable store/cache conformance cases.

store.intent: Read the actual app's SQLite cache location, schema and integrity.

store-proof.intent: Require a valid persistent database in the OS cache directory.

conformance.intent: Run the exported contract against real native SQL in a separate proof database.

conformance-proof.intent: Require every native conformance check to pass.

settings.intent: Open the actual app settings for the storage notice check.

no-fallback.intent: A successful native store does not show the memory fallback notice.

capture.intent: Record the connected native app after storage proof.
